task: Transcribe an English conversation and mark who spoke when
packaging_note: A separate download service retrieves pinned speech and speaker models; the offline transcription service has neither the token nor internet access.

access.why: The downloader authenticates to Hugging Face to fetch the speaker model. It cannot read your recording.

settings.name: HF_TOKEN
settings.what: a Hugging Face read token with access to the speaker model
settings.how: Sign in at https://huggingface.co/pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1 and review its conditions. After gaining access, create a read token and enter it in UGT's secret prompt.

inputs.what: an English conversation with distinguishable speakers

outputs.what: the full machine-readable segments and speaker labels

known_issues: Speaker labels are estimates, not names. Similar voices can be merged, especially on short or overlapping turns. Review the transcript against the recording before quoting anyone.
